description: This file defines the Drupal core 'Datetime' form element class, handling date and time input, validation, and formatting with support for HTML5 date/time types and custom callbacks.

classes.name: Datetime
classes.description: Provides a Drupal form element for date and time input, supporting HTML5 types, validation, and callbacks.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration array for the datetime form element, including formats, validation, processing, and theming.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes input values into DrupalDateTime objects, handling different input formats and time zones.

methods.name: processDatetime
methods.description: Expands a datetime element into separate date and time sub-elements with HTML5 attributes and validation.

methods.name: processAjaxForm
methods.description: Copies AJAX settings to child date and time elements.

methods.name: validateDatetime
methods.description: Validates the date and time input, ensuring required fields are filled and within valid year ranges.

methods.name: getHtml5DateFormat
methods.description: Returns the correct HTML5 date format based on the element's date type.

methods.name: getHtml5TimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the correct HTML5 time format based on the element's time type.
